Moscow also says it struck three vessels carrying military cargo near Odesa.Could Ukraine be shifting away from NATO toward a new European security alliance? articles.title: NCPCR Probes Meta Over Child Exploitation Ads | Instagram Under Scanner | Big Tech Faces Heat
articles.description: The National Commission for Protection of Child Rights (NCPCR) has launched a formal inquiry into Meta over allegations that advertisements linked to Child Sexual Exploitative and Abuse Material (CSEAM) appeared on its platforms. The inquiry follows a previous notice issued to the company after a BBC Eye investigation raised concerns about such advertisements. After reviewing Meta's response, the Commission has now escalated the matter into a formal fact-finding probe.The investigation is expected to examine the circumstances under which the alleged advertisements appeared, the effectiveness of Meta's content moderation systems, and whether existing safeguards were adequate to prevent the promotion of illegal content.
